about_the_game:
Don’t Hang Up delivers a focused, intense horror experience with a playtime of around 10–15 minutes.

You play as Ben, entering an abandoned apartment.
Your smartphone is your central tool — answer or reject calls, take notes, snap photos, use the flashlight, and influence the atmosphere through subtle interactions.

Features:

  • Fully functional smartphone interface
    (flashlight, selfies, notes, calls, menu navigation)

  • Scripted calls with choices
    (answer or hang up – sets the tone of the story)

  • Trigger-based sounds and a single, impactful jumpscare
    (one-time activation based on interaction and location)

  • In-game checklist integrated into the phone
    (players can manually add their own tasks)

  • No tutorial – no quest markers – no HUD
    (kept minimal for maximum immersion)

  • 5 detailed rooms to explore
    (kitchen, living room, bathroom, children’s room, bedroom)

  • Adjustable performance settings
    (scalable texture quality, shadow options)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: A tense single-player horror game where your phone is your only tool. Take unsettling calls, uncover hidden clues, and survive the unknown. Every call could be your last.
